itens.trecho: Construtivo, positivo e divertido. Esta é uma das comédias mais emblemáticas da viragem do século, e é provavelmente o trabalho mais notável de Jim Carrey, juntamente com "Mentiroso Compulsivo" e "Ace Ventura".

Bruce Almighty leverages Carrey's comedy strengths and a solid supporting cast to create a top-notch lighthearted comedy. Honestly, I had a traumatic experience from seeing The Mask way too young, and it left me terrified of Jim Carrey for quite a while. Even after I grew out of the Carreyphobia, I still wasn't a fan, but Bruce Almighty changed everything.

Jim Carrey and the interesting premise carry the movie for 55 min\ after which it devolves into a shallow, boring and generic love story and trite "life lesson" about being happy with what you have and have reverence for God. You can basically skip the second half and won't miss anything of relevance. Don't believe me?
